name: queue_basic
kind: survey: the bounded queues behind the hardware's mio_throttle and lg_throttle -- for shared-memory stores and loads, S2R, SHFL.IDX and MUFU (MIO side) and for global stores and loads (LG side): at which backlog a producer starts to wait at issue, the service interval per instruction kind and operand width, which kinds share a queue, whether the queue belongs to a warp, an SMSP or an SM, what a load behind stores waits for, and the sustained store rate by address form; installs nothing
mechanisms: MIO queue (mio_throttle at issue; no leaf today except the in-flight groups of mio_basic v4)
LG queue (lg_throttle at issue) and the global store rate: storage.global.store_issue (3 / 6 / 23 cycles per SMSP by width), the store-buffer gate of memory.store_l2
storage.shared.issue / acceptance / visibility (STS) and instruction.service of an LDS behind STS (short_scoreboard at the reader)
instruction.service of MUFU (resource xu_smsp): class of the wait at issue
why: Stage 2 of dev/design/stall-attribution.md section 0. Hardware books the wait of a saturated queue on the issuing instruction; the replay has no bound on the MIO side and a different store rate on the LG side. Full GPU (full-place5, points of residency, hardware / replay): mio_throttle 2.81 / 0.04 (H100) and 1.23 / 0.03 (B300); lg_throttle 0.60 / 1.06 and 0.43 / 0.51; short_scoreboard 5.56 / 2.63 and 5.61 / 3.10 (compare/place5/<set>/kind_gaps.tsv).
data_seen_before_freezing: mem_basic v1 readings (its addenda; tools/microbench/mem_basic/readings.py, $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/mem_basic-readings). One warp, per execution, both devices alike: a run of STS (4 B) issues its first 10 at one cycle each, the 11th waits 1.2 as mio_throttle and every later one 3.0 (4.0 cycles per store); STG (4 B, one line) the same with lg_throttle 3.9 on the 11th and 5.0 after (6.0 per store); LDG of a resident line lg_throttle 0.9 / 0.7 on the 11th and 3.0 after (4.0 per load). In the form 'issue k of a run (k = 0, 1, ...) not before r k - X': STS r = 4.0, X = 28.8; STG r = 6.0, X = 46.1; LDG r = 4.0, X = 29.1. A queue depth and a first-service time are not separable from single-kind runs (X = r D - L only). The reader behind four STS ; LDS pairs waits 38.0 / 38.5-43.3 where the replay has 22 (the difference is 4 stores x 4 cycles on H100); the reader behind four STG ; LDG pairs 69.2 / 70.4, 20 more than behind four LDG alone, while four LDS or S2R between four LDG leave the loads' reader where it is (49.1 / 51.7 against 49.0 / 49.7). Several warps (throttle per warp and iteration, H100 / B300): sts.n8.w8 1.3 / 0.6, sts.n8.w16 11.2 / 4.5, sts.n16.w16 134 / 129; stg.n8.w8 10.6 / 8.1, stg.n8.w16 129 / 123, stg.n16.w16 384 / 378; the replay has no wait on STS and store_buffer 881 / 391 and 1914 / 943 on the two STG cells (loop totals 4.1 / 2.3 times the hardware's at n16.w16). STL: lg_throttle 500 / 65 on four stores (not followed up here).

mio_basic r3 readings, one warp, 16 producers: mio_throttle 3.0 on LDS, 4.0 on SHFL.BFLY, 16.0 on SHFL.IDX, none on S2R (both devices); results of S2R / LDS / SHFL.BFLY return 2 apart in one chain per warp (installed, mio_basic v4).

plan_pilot v1: MUFU waits at issue as mio_throttle, about 7.2 cycles per MUFU from the third (H100) / fourth (B300) of a run; the replay's unit:xu_smsp has the right time and maps to math_pipe_throttle.

Census of the hardware reference of the full-GPU sets (500 + 500 cases, share of residency in points, by the pc that carries the class; tools/microbench/full_gpu_check/throttle_census.py, $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/throttle-census; also in the mem_basic addendum of the same date). H100 mio_throttle: MUFU 0.81 (EX2 0.70, TANH 0.11; mostly not back to back: the instruction in front is FADD / F2FP / FMNMX / FMUL), HGMMA 0.86, STS 0.21 + STSM 0.04 (STS.U8 0.10, STS.64 0.09; in runs of 4 and more), LDS 0.09, the TMA family about 0.3, LDC 0.04. B300 mio_throttle: MUFU 0.19, the tensor and TMA families about 0.5, STS.128 0.08, LDS 0.06, LDS.128 0.03, LDC 0.05. lg_throttle: H100 STG.E.U16 0.35 of 0.60 with F2FP or ISETP in front (stores separated by arithmetic, not runs), STG.E.128 0.04, LDG.E.128 0.04; B300 STG.E (4 B) 0.37 of 0.43 in runs of 10 and more. HGMMA, the tensor family and TMA belong to stages 4 and 5.

store_hazard repro (mem_basic addendum of the same date): m2.stg.n8.w16 / .n16.w16 with and without a read barrier on the stores. Under the reference pass's conditions (ncu, full metric list, flushed caches) the cubins without read barrier fail 5 of 120 runs (both devices, both cells), those with it 0 of 120; direct runs never fail; the read barrier does not change the timing (median cycles per iteration equal to 0.1). Stores can therefore still be unread about 100 cycles behind their issue when the caches are cold.

probe.chain: As mem_basic: tools/microbench/sync_basic harness (cells.tsv, probe/, build.sh, loop gate, run.sh; case names mb-sb-<cell>), frame -> ptxas -O3 -> free-mode sass_patch plan -> nvdisasm loop gate -> ptx_runner; set queue_basic, build dir $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/microbench/queue_basic/<device>/build, run root $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/queue_basic/<device>; direct clocks, capture, two reference passes (counters + per-pc samples), replay with build b046ee5c.
probe.frame q: q.loop.ptx, the m2 frame of mem_basic (64 iterations, 32 filler slots per iteration, clocks before and after, check word 64) with: a second shared slot and second global in / out blocks of 16 B per thread for the 8- and 16-byte forms; a register pair and a register quad that hold the value of the wide stores; a float register for MUFU / FADD / F2FP; a far region per warp whose pointer pair stays live and adjacent across the loop (anchors in front of and behind the loop) and advances by 0x800 per iteration through a frame instruction pair present in every cell, the region being long enough for the last iteration and the anchor behind the loop. The generator does not change the destination of any frame instruction to a register it has not shown to be dead there, and checks on the patched listing that every address register of a producer is written only by the instructions the frame intends. q.nop of this frame is run at every shape used.
probe.conventions: Producers and the reader as in mio_basic / mem_basic: stall 1, yield 1; loads and MUFU write their own destination (pairwise distinct within an iteration, outside R0-R9 and the frame's registers) and raise dependency barrier 0; a reader (integer add of the last destination into the scratch register, wait mask bit 0) sits directly behind the last producer when that is a load or MUFU and the cell is not a rate cell. Stores raise a read barrier that no loop instruction waits on, and the first instruction behind the loop that writes a source register of a store waits on it (the compiler's convention; mem_basic's stores had none). Slots not named keep a NOP with the replaced instruction's stall, except the gap slots of rate cells (below). Stored and loaded values are checked on the host.

producers.sts / sts8 / sts64 / sts128: STS / STS.U8 [Rb], Rtid to the thread's own word; STS.64 / STS.128 [Rbw], pair / quad to the thread's 16-byte slot.
producers.s2r, shfli, mufu, fadd, f2fp: S2R Rx, SR_TID.X; SHFL.IDX as mio_basic's m.shfl_idx; MUFU.EX2 Rx, Rf as plan_pilot's m.mufu; FADD Rx, Rf, Rf (dead destination); the F2FP form ptxas emits for a float-to-half pack on each target.
producers.stg / stg16 / stg64 / stg128: STG.E / STG.E.U16 desc[UR][Rout.64], Rtid (one 128-B line per warp, the same line throughout); STG.E.64 / .128 desc[UR][Routw.64], pair / quad (16 B per thread: four lines per warp).
producers.stgd: as stg, producer k writes line k mod 8 of the warp's 8-line block.
producers.stgfar: as stg, producer k of an iteration writes line k of the 16 lines the far pointer has advanced to: lines the kernel has not touched in this launch.
producers.ldg / ldg128 / ldgd / ldgfar: LDG.E Rx, desc[UR][Rin.64] (resident line); LDG.E.128 quad, desc[UR][Rinw.64]; ldgd line k of the block; ldgfar line k of the fresh far lines.

cell forms.run q.<p>.n<N>[.w<W>]: N producers p in consecutive slots from the first usable slot behind the frame's compare; W warps per CTA (default 1), one CTA per SM.
cell forms.sequence q.seq.<a><Na>_<b><Nb>: Na producers a directly followed by Nb producers b.
cell forms.rate q.<p>.e<E>[.w<W>]: producer p in every E-th usable slot from the first to the last usable slot of the iteration, the slots between as NOPs with stall 1 and yield 1 (FADD for mufu, F2FP ; ISETP for stg16_f2fp); no reader.
cell forms.forward q.fwd.<s><M>_<l>2[.x|.s]: M stores s, then two loads l, then the reader.

derivation.per cell: per warp and iteration from the per-pc samples of both reference passes (tools/microbench/mem_basic/readings.py: the hardware's selected sample moved back to its instruction, every other class on the pc that carries it) against the replay ledger; clock period per iteration from launches 0 and 2. Every warp executes every loop pc, so a per-warp average is a per-execution value; where a class sits on a pc only part of the warps reach, the reading says so and converts.
derivation.onset and service: per run cell the wait at issue of producer k (k = 0 .. N-1) and its class; r = the steady wait + 1; X from the first waiting k; whether n16, n24 and n28 lie on one line.
derivation.depth: the sequence cells against the FIFO family below.
derivation.scope: wait per warp against warps per SMSP and per SM at equal n; per-SM rate at 16 and 32 warps (producers per SM and iteration over the loop total less q.nop).
derivation.rate: per rate cell the loop total per iteration against q.nop and the wait per store; the sustained cycles per store.
derivation.forward: reader wait against M, and .x / .s against the plain cell.
derivation.control: q.sts.n16, q.stg.n16, q.stg.n16.w16, q.sts.n16.w16 against the same cells of mem_basic (stores without read barrier): differences beyond the two-pass spread are reported.

questions_before_data.Q1 (onset, service): Per kind and width: r and X. Expected from mem_basic if the line holds: q.sts.n24 / .n28 3.0 per store from the 12th on, q.stg.n24 / .n28 5.0, q.ldg.n24 3.0. Open: STS.U8 / .64 / .128, STG.U16 / .64 / .128, LDS, SHFL.IDX, S2R, the wide loads.
questions_before_data.Q2 (depth): Candidates: (F-d) one FIFO per queue with depth d, entries served one after another, each taking its kind's r, a producer waits at issue until entry k - d has left; d = 8 with a first service of about 3 cycles and d = 10 with about 11 both fit mem_basic. They differ on q.seq.sts6_lds18 if LDS takes 2 and STS 4: the producers that wait 3 cycles are indices 10-13 under d = 8 and 10-15 under d = 10, the later ones wait 1; q.seq.lds12_sts12 and the LG pair give the same test with the roles swapped. (T) no FIFO but a rate limit with a burst allowance per kind: the wait of a producer depends only on its own kind's history, so in a sequence cell the second kind starts with its own free burst.
questions_before_data.Q3 (membership): For each pair of q.seq.<a>10_<b>6: b waits at issue from its first producer on (one queue) or issues freely (separate queues or allowances). Expected from mem_basic's mixes: two queues (MIO: STS, LDS, S2R, SHFL; LG: STG, LDG) that do not hold each other up at one warp; MUFU's place is open; at 16 warps the STG and LDG pcs also carry a little mio_throttle (mem_basic), so the two sides may meet at the SM.
questions_before_data.Q4 (scope): Per warp: n5 and n10 at 8 and 16 warps show no wait beyond what the issue slot costs, n12 the one-warp wait. Per SMSP: n5.w8 (10 per SMSP) free, n10.w8 and n5.w16 (20 per SMSP) wait as a run of 20. Per SM: n5.w16 (80 per SM) waits heavily. mem_basic: stg.n8.w8 already waits 10.6 / 8.1 (not per warp), sts.n8.w8 1.3 / 0.6.
questions_before_data.Q5 (store rate, address form): Sustained cycles per STG at 1, 8, 16 warps for the same line, eight lines, fresh lines, and 2-byte stores between arithmetic; expected from the one-line runs: one warp sustains a store every 6 cycles (q.stg.e6 free, q.stg.e2 / .e3 / .e4 at 6.0 per store), 16 warps about 1.7 cycles per store per SM. Whether fresh lines are slower is open. STS likewise against 4.0.
questions_before_data.Q6 (load behind stores): (S) serial queue: the reader's wait grows by the stores' r per store in front (4 M for STS, 6 M for STG) whatever word or line the load reads; (V) visibility of the stored address: growth only when the load reads what was stored (.x flat, .s above the plain cell). mem_basic's 38.0 against 22 fits (S) with 4 x 4.
questions_before_data.Q7 (MUFU): With one MUFU every 2 or 4 slots: is the wait at issue still mio_throttle at about 7.2 cycles per MUFU per SMSP, and where does it sit at 8 and 16 warps; does F2FP wait at issue, in which class, and does it share MUFU's spacing; do MUFU and STS hold each other up (C cells).
questions_before_data.Q8 (far loads): mem_basic's Q6: reader wait and result spacing when every load misses L1; lg_throttle on the producers.

install: Nothing. Readings go into the addenda; installation protocols follow, book-keeping (the class of MUFU's wait) separate from timing (MIO queue, LG queue and store rate).
not_allowed: No value from another machine or from the literature; no full-GPU case or error used to choose a rule or a value (the census above only chose which forms to measure); no cell dropped after its data is seen.

addenda.when: 2026-11-21, before the run (realisation of the probes; no data)
addenda.text: All 100 cells per device are realised (unrealised.txt: none; it lists the SASS form of every producer). Realisation notes, each fixed before any run: (1) Frame q.loop.ptx uses 118 / 120 registers per thread (36 single and 12 quad destinations); a CTA of 1024 threads allows 64, so the three 32-warp cells (q.nop.w32, q.sts.n16.w32, q.stg.n16.w32) are built from q.loop32.ptx, the same frame without the destination pool (the generator asserts that the loop's instruction stream is the same up to register numbers); their frame reference is q.nop.w32 of that frame. (2) Usable slots per iteration: 30, so the rate cells hold 15 (e2), 10 (e3), 8 (e4) and 5 (e6) producers per iteration. (3) Read barrier of the stores as the conventions say; where no instruction behind the loop writes a store source (the 64- and 128-bit forms) there is no waiting instruction. In the stgfar cells the far pointer is a store source that the frame's advance writes every iteration: the advance waits on the stores' read barrier, so a warp does not start iteration j + 1 before its far stores of iteration j have read their operands; that wait sits on the advance's pc (a frame pc) and is reported with the cell. (4) Cells with loads, S2R, SHFL.IDX or MUFU but no reader (sequences that end in stores or F2FP, the MUFU rate cells): the first instruction behind the loop that writes a source or destination register of those producers waits on barrier 0; only five plans have such an instruction (sm_90a: q.mufu.e2, q.mufu.e4, q.seq.mufu10_sts6, q.seq.mufu4_f2fp4; sm_103a: q.seq.lds12_sts12). (5) Host check, narrower than the conventions' sentence: the check word of every cell and the stored global values (tools/microbench/queue_basic/check_values.py: the thread's word of the narrow output block, the eight lines of the stgd cells, the pair and quad of the wide output block); far stores, shared-memory stores and loaded values are not visible to the host and are not checked. (6) Forms as realised: .x reads the wide shared slot with a 4-byte LDS; .s reads [Rout]; the gap ISETP of q.stg16_f2fp writes P6 from the tid register; the reader of a quad load adds the quad's first register. (7) Buffers per warp: narrow in / out 1024 B, far 135168 B (66 blocks of 0x800), wide in / out 4096 B; shared memory 20480 B per CTA. Plan checks (tools/microbench/sync_basic/check_m_plans.py, every q plan on both targets): destinations distinct and outside the frame, read barrier and waiting instruction of every store, no writer of any producer's address / descriptor / data register from the frame's anchors through the loop branch except the far advance on the far pair, the far advance and the anchor behind the loop on the same pair.

addenda.text: Run: on both devices 100 of 100 cells pass the loop gate, the direct run, the check word and the stored-value check (0 wrong words), are captured, have both reference passes (200 of 200 with rc 0: no failed launch with the read barriers) and are replayed; sync_basic_RC 0. All values per warp and per iteration (= per execution), H100 / B300, hardware pass a (pass b in the tables), 'wait' = every class except selected on the producer's own pc. Frame: q.nop 134.8 / 135.4, .w4 133.1 / 132.6, .w8 134.2 / 134.4, .w16 147.6 / 148.3, .w32 (small frame) 231.1 / 204.2; replay 135.0 / 135.4, 135.0 / 135.4, 137.2 / 137.5, 152.4 / 154.9, 283.6 / 291.3. Control against mem_basic (stores without read barrier): one warp the same (q.sts.n16 mio_throttle 15.8 / 15.9 against 16.0 / 15.8, q.stg.n16 lg_throttle 28.7 / 28.8 against 29.0 / 28.7); at 16 warps the q cells are 3-6 % shorter (q.sts.n16.w16 250.4 / 251.9 against 265.2 / 259.6, q.stg.n16.w16 506.4 / 504.5 against 522.5 / 514.7) as is the frame (147.6 / 148.3 against 150.3 / 152.9): frame and day are not separated from the read barrier here; the store_hazard repro had the same cubin with and without it at equal periods. Q1 (one warp; r = sustained cycles per producer, X as in data seen). STS 4 B: n16 and n24 wait from producer 11 (1.1 / 1.0, 0.8 / 1.2) then 2.93-2.99 each: r = 4.0, X = 28.2-29.1; n28 waits from producer 8 because 28 stores at 4.0 fill the whole iteration (112.7 / 112.8 = 28 x 4.02) and the queue is not empty when the next iteration starts -- the expectation named producer 12 for n28 and is wrong on the onset, right on the rate. STS.U8 as STS (r 3.98 / 4.00). STS.64 r = 7.9 / 7.9, STS.128 r = 10.0 / 9.95 (loop total over 24). STG 4 B r = 6.0 (n16 X = 45.6 / 45.8; n24 6.02 / 6.01, n28 5.97 / 6.01 per store), STG.U16 as STG (5.98 / 5.97), STG.64 r = 7.94 / 7.92, STG.128 r = 11.92 / 11.91. LDG r = 4.0 (wait 2.96-3.01 from producer 12, X = 28.6-28.7), reader 67.1 / 68.4 behind 16 and 67.4 / 64.5 behind 24. LDS r = 2.0: producers 14 on wait 1.0 each (X = 11.4-11.8), reader 34.2 / 34.2 (n24) where the replay's reader has 44.7 / 43.7: the loop totals agree (105.6 / 105.7 against 105.2 / 104.5), the hardware books 10.9 of the time on the producers. SHFL.IDX r = 4.0 from producer 11 (X = 28.6), reader 54.0 / 54.4 against the replay's 83.7 with equal totals (153.8 / 155.2 against 154.0 / 154.3). S2R: no wait on 28 producers, reader 48.9 / 49.0 = the replay's 48.6. LDS.128 (n12): no wait at issue, reader 107.7 / 107.3 (replay 56.8 / 44.8); LDG.128 (n12): producers 11 and 12 wait as LDG, reader 123.0 / 124.5 (replay 98.1 / 86.2). Q2 (depth): d = 10 on both devices and for both pairs. q.seq.sts6_lds18: producer 11 waits 1.1 / 1.0, producers 12-16 2.4-3.4 / 2.7-3.5 (the stores' pace), producers 17-24 0.9-1.1 / 0.7-1.2 (the loads' pace): the producers held at the stores' pace are indices 10-15 as (F-10) predicts, not 10-13. q.seq.lds12_sts12: the first store 0, the next nine 0.8-1.2 / 0.8-1.7, the last two 3.1, 2.7 / 2.8, 3.3: the pace changes at producer 23 = 13 + 10. q.seq.stg6_ldg18: producer 11 3.8 / 4.2, 12-16 4.7-4.8 / 5.0-5.2, 17-24 3.0-3.2 / 2.8-2.9. q.seq.ldg12_stg12: the waits start at producer 8 (iteration too short to drain), the loads' pace holds through producer 22, the last two stores wait 4.5, 4.5 / 5.0, 4.7. Candidate (T) is rejected: the second kind never starts with a free burst of its own. With d = 10 the first entry of a run leaves L = 10 r - X after its issue: LDS 8.3-8.6, STS 10.9-11.8, LDG and SHFL.IDX 11.3-11.4, STG 13.9-14.4, about 5.5 + 1.5 r on both devices (an observation; no service model is chosen here). Q3 (membership): STS, LDS, SHFL.IDX, LDG and STG (and the wide forms) share one queue -- the expectation of two queues that do not hold each other up at one warp is wrong. In every q.seq.<a>10_<b>6 of these kinds b waits from its first producer at a's pace: sts10_shfli6 0.9 / 1.1 then 2.8-3.1; sts10_lds128x6 1.1 / 1.0 then 2.6-3.1; sts10_ldg6 1.6 / 0.6 then 2.5-3.0 / 2.3-4.2; sts10_stg6 0.9 / 1.0 then 2.9-3.1; stg10_sts6 3.0 / 3.0 then 4.8-5.1; stg10_lds6 2.9 / 3.4 then 4.1-5.9 / 3.8-5.4; ldg10_sts6 first store 0.0 / 0.1, then 2.5-3.3 / 2.9-3.1. Class of the wait: lg_throttle only when the waiting producer and the entries in front of it are both global (STG behind STG or LDG, LDG behind LDG or STG); mio_throttle in every other pairing, including an STG or LDG behind STS and an STS or LDS behind STG or LDG. Outside the queue: S2R (above; q.seq.s2r10_sts6 no wait) and MUFU (sts10_mufu6: the MUFU wait as alone, third 10.8 then 7.1 on H100, fourth 7.8 then 3.1 on B300; mufu10_sts6: the stores do not wait). Not separated: whether entries of different kinds leave strictly in issue order when the kinds alternate (mem_basic's 4 + 4 mixes showed LDS between LDG not delaying the LDG results); no cell here alternates beyond the depth.
